description: This file defines Pydantic data models and related classes for a chatbot platform, including message formats, session management, retrieval, and orchestration requests.

classes.name: Message
classes.description: Represents a single chat message with metadata and timestamp.

classes.name: ChatRequest
classes.description: Payload for requesting a chat message, including session and context info.

classes.name: ChatResponse
classes.description: Contains the assistant's reply message along with source citations and reasoning steps.

classes.name: SessionCreateRequest
classes.description: Request model for creating a new tutoring session with optional initial context.

classes.name: Session
classes.description: Represents a tutoring session with context and timestamps.

classes.name: RetrievalQuery
classes.description: Model for querying the retrieval system with a natural language query.

classes.name: RetrievalDocument
classes.description: Represents a document retrieved for source citations with score and metadata.

classes.name: OrchestrateRequest
classes.description: Request to run multiple agents on a task with optional RAG settings.

classes.name: OrchestrateResponse
classes.description: Response from orchestrator containing final message, involved agents, and reasoning steps.

classes.name: AgentRole
classes.description: String subclass used as an identifier for agent roles.
